summary:
Ran 10 iterative-arm trials each for task-transcript (trials 75-84) and locale-sum (trials 30-39). Results:

task-transcript: on-iterative 9/10 (90%) — massive improvement over on-gated 2/25 (8%), matches on-search 7/8 (88%).
locale-sum: on-iterative 0/10 (0%) — no improvement, same as on-autonomous; on-gated 7/12 (58%) and on-search 6/6 (100%) are far better.

Iterative mode is highly effective for task-transcript but fails completely on locale-sum. The two candidates respond oppositely to iterative retrieval.

subject: Bench iterative arm: task-transcript + locale-sum, 10 trials each
description: After #24 lands and daemon restarted, run 10 iterative-arm trials each for task-transcript and locale-sum via bench-heldout.js. Tally vs off/search/gated/autonomous.
